meta.title: Johan Nilsson — Operator & Investor in Premium Consumer Brands
meta.description: Johan Nilsson: twenty-five years building premium consumer brands in fitness, wellness, sport and hospitality. Barry’s in the Nordics, Iberia and Switzerland; Stockholm Leisure Partners; boards of Svensk Innebandy and AIK.

sections.label: The practice
sections.statement: The discipline of a global brand, <t>built one market at a time.</t>
body: Twenty-five years in business development, strategy and operations across fitness, wellness, sport and hospitality: strategy consulting at EY and Cordial, strategy and business development for SATS and Health & Fitness Nordic, then ten years building Barry’s in the Nordics as CEO and partner.
Today, a partner in Barry’s Iberia and Barry’s Switzerland, founding partner of Stockholm Leisure Partners, and a board member of Svensk Innebandy and AIK.

A first studio that works, and a second, third and fourth that need to work the same way.

A founder with a fitness or wellness concept, looking for capital that understands the floor as well as the spreadsheet.
A board that needs someone at the table who has carried a P&L.
A federation or club that wants its elite game run with the discipline of a commercial brand.

sections.label: The defining chapter
sections.title: Barry’s <t>in the Nordics.</t>
sections.body: A boutique fitness brand from Los Angeles, brought to Stockholm in 2016 and built studio by studio. In January 2022 the Swedish and Norwegian companies merged into the region’s largest boutique operator; the work then moved on to Spain, Switzerland and Finland.
